definition.interpretation: The mock simulation (exp-continuity-simulation-002) returned a reward variance of 0.03, which falls within the predefined stability threshold of 0.05. This result satisfies the prediction rule for the tested protocol, but does not provide causal evidence for agent stability, as it is a simulated proxy. It confirms the feasibility of measuring variance, but not the dynamics of locally-linear learning.
definition.limitations: The current protocol relies on simulated variance outcomes rather than executing actual locally-linear learning formulations. The result is a baseline, not a validation of agent behavior in complex task-learning environments.
definition.next_step: Refactor the experiment protocol to execute authentic locally-linear learning formulations on synthetic agent environments rather than returning mock values.

actions.next_step: Implement and run a robust locally-linear learning simulation to replace mock protocol.
actions.question: When does an intelligent system have a rational reason to preserve its own continuity?
actions.reason: Previous simulation was a mock implementation; meaningful stability assessment requires executing authentic learning dynamics.
actions.title: Continuity Rationale and Instrumental Value

definition.cost: Moderate: requires implementing or integrating a locally-linear learning Python module.
definition.next_experiment: Design and execute an experiment using real locally-linear learning code.
definition.reason: The project is active and the mock simulation was a diagnostic test for the measurement pipeline rather than the research question.
definition.stop_condition: Failure to demonstrate stable preference distributions across three independent, authentic learning trials.
definition.uncertainty: The initial mock simulation provides no validation of agent learning dynamics or stability; whether locally-linear learning models actually exhibit consistent preference distributions remains unknown.

proposal.summary: Interpretation of mock continuity variance experiment and adjustment of the project research trajectory to target more rigorous implementation.
proposal.title: Continuity Rationale and Instrumental Value: Experimental Interpretation and Project Advancement
